rationale: The workflow repeatedly fetches/installs PDM dependencies (pdm update && pdm sync) in the testing job, every cell of the 15-cell compatibility matrix, and the build-n-install job, with no dependency cache present. This matches the P-LIT-GHA-CACHE dependency_cache pattern: repeated dependency fetching is measurable, and cache inputs can include the lockfile/environment (pyproject.toml, pdm.lock, Python version, runner OS). Adding actions/cache@v4 for the PDM cache directory (~/.cache/pdm) before each install step preserves all existing checks and coverage while reducing repeated dependency download time. No contraindications apply: there is no equivalent cache already, and the cached content is dependency wheels rather than mutable/untrusted build outputs. No permissions are weakened, no secrets or privileged actions are added, and no new network access beyond the existing PyPI dependency installation is introduced.
